articles.summary: Grew Net Sales 2.1% to $10.4 Billion, Net Income 42.5% to $218 Million and Diluted EPS 49.3% to $1.00 Grew Adjusted EBITDA 9.9% to $555 Million and Adjusted Diluted EPS 17.8% to $1.26 Independent Restaurant Case Growth of 5.0% Acquired Prime Line Distributors in October and Repurchased $191 Million of USFD Shares US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD), one of the largest foodservice distributors in the United States, today announced results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026. Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Highlights Total case volume increased 1.3%; independent restaurant case volume increased 5.0% Net sales increased 2.1% to $10.4 billion Gross profit increased 8.6% to $1.9 billion Net income increased 42.5% to $218 million Net income margin increased 60 basis points to 2.1% Adjusted EBITDA 1 increased 9.9% to $555 million Adjusted EBITDA margin 1 increased 38 basis points to 5.3% Diluted EPS increased 49.3% to $1.00; Adjusted Diluted EPS 1 increased 17.8% to $1.26
articles.title: US Foods Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Earnings
